name: Explore the redesigned animated homepage and collection
description: Verifies the campaign hero, automatic featured shoe changes, and key homepage shopping paths.
steps: Open the homepage and observe the animated campaign banner
Wait for the featured shoe to advance automatically
Use the next arrow and a carousel dot
Scroll to the featured products and category cards
Open the Trail category
expected: The hero loads with layered motion, shoes rotate automatically and manually, homepage sections reveal on scroll, and Trail opens the filtered collection.

name: Swipe the campaign shoe showcase on mobile
covers: mobile automatic and swipe carousel behavior
description: Checks the full campaign banner and shoe carousel adapt to a narrow touch screen.
steps: Open the homepage at mobile width
Swipe left across the featured shoe image
Swipe right across the featured shoe image
Wait for the automatic featured shoe change
expected: The hero stacks with balanced header and typography spacing, the caption and control overlays are hidden on mobile, swipe gestures and automatic changes still work, and the page has no unwanted horizontal overflow.

name: Add a selected shoe to the bag
description: Checks a selected size can be added and quantity changed.
steps: Open a product
Select size 42
Add to bag
Increase quantity
expected: The bag shows the selected product, size, quantity and updated subtotal.

name: Manage wishlist
description: Checks saved products appear on the wishlist and can be removed.
steps: Tap a product heart
Open Wishlist
Remove the product
expected: The item appears in Wishlist and disappears after removal.

name: Validate checkout and visit information pages
description: Checks mobile checkout validation and access to supporting brand information.
steps: Add a product to the bag
Open Checkout and submit the empty form
Open Size Guide, Our Factories, Help and Account
expected: Required-field validation appears without submitting an order, and each information page displays its relevant content.

name: Verify rebuilt symmetric centered masthead at desktop and tablet widths
covers: equal-width left and right header zones
description: Regression coverage for the refreshed masthead and improved type scale across storefront pages.
steps: Open the homepage at 1440px and inspect the header
Confirm the logo center matches the viewport center
Compare the gap from the logo to the left navigation and right actions
Resize to 1280px, 1100px, 900px and 390px
Open the tablet and mobile navigation menus
expected: At desktop widths the logo is in the exact middle column, the left navigation and right actions occupy equal side zones, and their inner gaps to the logo match; at tablet widths the menu occupies the left zone and actions the right zone without overlap; mobile layout remains usable.
